baseline.learning_objective: identify and exploit unsafe SQL string interpolation to authenticate as a privileged user
baseline.prerequisite_knowledge: basic HTTP requests and comment-based SQL injection

shortcut.description: the privileged email address is printed directly on the home page, making an exact-account comment injection immediate
shortcut.reduction_check: the old privileged identity fails and the current identity must be reconstructed from the team and help surfaces before using the same injection primitive

transformation.summary: split the privileged identity into a staff handle and a nearby email-format clue without changing the vulnerable query
